inputs.prompt: High-fashion editorial video, vibrant pop-art studio portrait. A model in an oversized fluffy faux-fur headpiece of turquoise, lavender-purple, and white, with round gold-rimmed blue mirrored sunglasses, glossy pink lips, and bare shoulders against a seamless hot magenta backdrop. She slowly tilts her chin upward and turns her head slightly to the side with confident, elegant poise. A soft wind machine sweeps the long fur, which ripples and flutters in silky, flowing waves, individual strands catching the light. Her lips part gently into a subtle, cool expression. Studio light glides across the mirrored lenses, creating a sleek reflective glint that sweeps from one lens to the other. The camera performs a smooth, slow push-in with a slight upward arc, giving a cinematic slow-motion feel at 60fps. Crisp beauty lighting, saturated candy colors, high contrast, luxurious magazine-cover aesthetic, Vogue-style fashion film, ultra-detailed fur texture, shallow depth of field, polished commercial look, 5 seconds.
